negative_scan.law: NO outcome numbers anywhere in D1 artifacts. Two independent scanners were run over every string and scalar leaf of all four committed proposals: (a) an outcome-metric token scan (matches inside negated contexts such as 'no PnL', 'no expectancies', 'never a return' are not outcome claims and are excluded by a negation guard); (b) a numeric-leaf structural scan - every numeric leaf must live inside a declared citation container of committed upstream structural facts (feasibility floors/coverage/cost ceilings, P2 grid census, P0 CoT census). Rule parameters in the families are strings (symbolic), never numbers. Both scanners are themselves tested against synthetic violating fixtures in tests/test_commodities_ng1_d1.py.
